meetOurTeam.title: The meeting of 5 talents who share the same vision
meetOurTeam.subtitle: Meet our team

members.name: NELLY AHOBAUT
members.bio: She began her career in recruitment and training reception hostesses in the Events sector. Her passion for sales was revealed during her 3 years at an English training company, before evolving into managing a telemarketing platform. This led her to open up to the distance selling sector in a company that gave her the opportunity to enhance her skills, eventually becoming its General Manager. Drawing on these experiences, she decided to launch into entrepreneurship and bring her own vision of Management and Customer Relations.

members.name: NICOLAS DECRESSAC
members.bio: His atypical background (printer then bookseller before focusing on implant machining for optics) led him to turn to configuration and customer service for major brands. He experienced entrepreneurship in computer maintenance before returning to salaried work as a Developer in the Distance Selling company where he met Nelly. His forward-thinking ideas and commitment to his passion brought to life a vision they share together. His adaptability and open-mindedness enable ANTL to express its project with innovative and dynamic energy. In a word, he is the Team's Magician.

members.name: SONIA HADID
members.bio: It was abroad that she was initiated into distance selling within several renowned call centers. Standing out from others through her relational qualities and technical skills, she was noticed by Nelly who called her to France to train her in management. While managing teams of salespeople that she trains and supervises, her results progressively project her to the top of the pyramid. She is entrusted with larger teams, then the management of a profit center. 15 years of experience in distance selling, including 10 in management positions, make her the ideal candidate at the head of ANTL's production, a project she believed in from its presentation and which she carries with exceptional conviction and loyalty.

members.name: LAËTITIA CASTANET
members.bio: She then distinguishes herself from other collaborators through her resilience capacity, her rigor at work and the precision of her analyses are the result of a transversal experience. A clever blend of her achievements in the worlds of entrepreneurship and salaried work. Her understanding of human functioning has roots in highly developed emotional intelligence. A rare quality noticed by Nelly, who prepares her for the Trainer position in the company where they met. This extraordinary personality has chosen to express her talents within ANTL's team where she ensures training, control of speech quality and processes.

members.name: MEHDI SAAD ALLAH
members.bio: Take 5 years in the army, 2 years in logistics and a small experience as a teleadvisor; add 5 years in flight for renowned airlines, and you get the perfect combo to ensure "ANTL's Showcase". A zest of passion for photography and video games are the ingredients that suffice to convince Nelly to propose him to accompany her in the ANTL adventure. He becomes her support, her second, her partner in communication policy and brand image. His organizational and relational qualities make him a central actor, he is in charge of all administrative aspects of the company and takes care of its image on platforms.
